comment: Dispatch surface of the specialized SM90 sparse-MLA decode kernel (sparse_mla_decode_sm90). 'backends' lists the backend strings of this API; the op entry carries the auto-routing keys backend='auto' matches a call against (the compiled-in guards in flashinfer/mla/_sparse_mla_sm90.py stay authoritative for eligibility) plus the qualified envelope. FLASHINFER_SPECIALIZED_KERNEL_DISABLE=1 disables the specialized kernel regardless of this file: backend='auto' routes to the composable 'reference' path, explicit backend='specialized' raises.
